killedBy: the campaign board unlock (issue #983) unlocks exactly the boards of the levels cleared so far, and every board no level plays
the campaign board unlock (issue #983) pairs a board with its level through the level's arenaId -- not the board's id, and not arena numbering
the campaign board unlock (issue #983) offers a fresh save, and a save two levels in, exactly these boards at each startable option
the campaign board unlock (issue #983) unlocking a board offers it at exactly the counts and modes its entry declares

why: The opposite off-by-one to `versus-unlock-frontier-level-unlocked`: the board of the level just cleared stays locked until the NEXT clear, so a player who beats level 1 finds Arena 1 still missing from versus and a player who finishes the campaign never sees Arena 5. Both directions are pinned because the ordinal is 1-based and the index is not, and either slip reads as plausible. Proved before its tests existed, by hand: the pre-#983 test file passed 0 failed of 20 with this mutation applied; then KILLED by 6 of 29, measured.
